name.hr: Lažna prometna kazna SMS-om: platite u 48 sati preko poveznice
name.en: Fake traffic fine by text: pay within 48 hours through a link

how.hr: SMS ili e-pošta tvrdi da je vaše vozilo evidentirano zbog prekršaja iz Zakona o sigurnosti prometa na cestama i da kaznu možete platiti online u 48 sati, inače slijede ovrha, veća kazna ili oduzimanje vozačke. Poveznica vodi na stranicu koja oponaša e-Prekršaje ili e-Građane, traži registraciju vozila i zatim podatke kartice.
how.en: A text or email says your vehicle was recorded committing an offence under the Road Traffic Safety Act and that you can pay the fine online within 48 hours, or face enforcement, a higher fine or losing your licence. The link leads to a page imitating e-Prekršaji or e-Građani that asks for your number plate and then your card details.

text.en: A “police” message about an unpaid traffic fine.

text.hr: Rok od 48 sati i prijetnja ovrhom ili oduzimanjem vozačke.
text.en: A 48-hour deadline and threats of enforcement or losing your licence.
A link to a fake e-Prekršaji page.

text.hr: Traže broj kartice i CVV za plaćanje.
text.en: They ask for your card number and CVV to pay.

text.hr: MUP RH: Za vaše vozilo utvrđen je prekršaj prekoračenja brzine. Iznos kazne umanjuje se ako platite u roku od 48 sati. Nakon isteka roka predmet se upućuje na prisilnu naplatu. Detalji i plaćanje: [poveznica]
text.en: Ministry of the Interior: A speeding offence has been recorded for your vehicle. The fine is reduced if you pay within 48 hours. After that the case goes to enforced collection. Details and payment: [link]

en: text about a traffic fine to pay online
road traffic offence text with link
pay police fine by card link

hr: Policija ne šalje obavijesti o prometnim kaznama ni zahtjeve za plaćanje SMS-om.
Adresa stranice nije službena adresa e-Prekršaja ni e-Građana.
Prijetnja ovrhom u 48 sati služi za paniku.
en: The police don’t send traffic fine notices or payment requests by text.
The page address is not the official e-Prekršaji or e-Građani address.
A 48-hour enforcement threat is meant to cause panic.

hr: Ne odgovarajte i ne otvarajte poveznicu. Obrišite poruku.
Ako ste upisali karticu, odmah nazovite banku.
en: Don’t reply or open the link. Delete the message.
If you entered your card, call your bank straight away.
